reviewContext.userProblem: stria v0.1 has its accepted design (72246dd) and wave 1 (foundation contracts and repo rename, 2ea8582) committed. The remaining product still has to be built: the SQLite page store with FTS search, page rendering and compressed BLOBs, the PNG cache, agent-gateway OCR and Q&A services, import and resumable OCR, ask/search/history RAG, the JSON CLI for agents, app view models and the SwiftUI reader app. The previous fanout failed only because a plan declared a SwiftPM checkout path.
requiredOutcomes: Data root ~/.local/stria, overridden by STRIA_HOME and the --home CLI flag, with stria.sqlite, originals/, cache/, config.json and logs/; tests and smoke runs use temp roots only.
Content-derived document id (first 16 hex chars of SHA-256); idempotent import; resumable interrupted import; idCollision on id clash with a different hash.

Import pipeline: copy original, render each page (150 DPI default, 4096 px cap), store HEIC (JPEG fallback) BLOBs in SQLite, then OCR per page through agent-gateway; import succeeds with pages pending or failed when OCR is unavailable; OCR is resumable, retryable and bounded in concurrency.
Expanded PNG cache at cache/<docId>/page-NNNN.png, written on app open, CLI page image, OCR and ask; valid files are not rewritten; never used for display.

SQLite schema v1 via system SQLite3 with user_version migrations, FTS5 trigram search over NFKC OCR text with a LIKE fallback (short queries and hosts without FTS5 trigram), chat threads and messages, agent_runs.

agent-gateway at revision c7f269753ec36aca92d429ec13316ba033128967 as the only AI library (Mode A), behind OCRService and AgentService, with fakes for tests; cursor-api is rejected as unavailable before any call; every call recorded in agent_runs and logs/agent-runs-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.
CLI stria with JSON output and stable exit codes: import, ocr, list, show, page image, page text, search, ask (--doc, --page, --query, --limit), history, config get/set, paths.

macOS 14 SwiftUI app modelled on Preview, Skim, PDF Expert and AI-assistant readers: library home; NavigationSplitView left pane (Contents, Thumbnails, Search); center PDFView with continuous vertical scroll, page field, Go to Page Cmd-Opt-G and last-read restore; right .inspector agent pane with scope picker, citation chips, Cmd-Return send and This page / This PDF history.
swift build, swift test (no network, no credentials), swiftlint, files under 1000 lines, and scripts/cli-smoke.sh with a temp STRIA_HOME all pass.
nonGoals: No riela dependency, workflow files or riela data directory (design-docs/user-qa/no-riela-decision.md).
No modification of /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/agent-gateway, no local-path dependency, no Package.swift or Package.resolved change.
No Mode B / unavailable fallback services: agent-gateway resolves and builds at the pinned revision.
No changes to the completed P01 foundation contracts (Paths, Config, Errors, Models, Services, OCRService, AgentService, StriaEnvironment, test Support).
No .app bundle, Info.plist, icon or signing for stria-app in v0.1.
No streaming answers, per-call timeout or agent session reuse.
No document deletion and no migrations beyond v1.
No annotations, tabs or two-up display modes in the app.
constraints: Follow AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, Swift coding skill, every Swift file under 1000 lines, run swiftlint.
macOS 14+ only, Swift tools 6.0, Swift 6 language mode.
Workers write only their plan's writePaths and only the Progress Log of their own plan file; sharedPaths are read-only.
Workers make no git state changes (no add, commit, mv, stash, checkout, reset, switch, branch, worktree); commits happen in serial finalization.
Declared-path policy above: never declare .build, checkouts, build outputs, tmp/ or nested-.git directories.
Tests and smoke runs never write to ~/.local/stria or into the repository tree outside tmp/.
No secret values are printed, logged, stored or committed; config holds env var names only.
Commit messages carry no AI tool attribution or co-authorship lines (repository policy).
Run verification commands in the foreground and keep complete logs with exit codes under the evidenceRoot.
designDecisionsAndRationale: riela is dropped (user decision); per-call logging is covered by agent_runs plus JSONL logs.
HEIC at quality 0.75 with automatic JPEG fallback: about half of JPEG size for text pages; PNG only on expansion because vendors do not accept HEIC.
System SQLite3 with a thin wrapper and the FTS5 trigram tokenizer, probed once in migration 1 and recorded in meta, with a LIKE fallback.
Queries with any term shorter than 3 Unicode scalars use LIKE mode because FTS5 trigram phrases under 3 characters never match.
View models live in StriaCore/AppModel so swift test covers app behaviour.
Gate G1 is closed: design-docs/references/agent-gateway-c7f2697.md is the API source of truth; gatewayImageContentBlocks(.filePath) inlines images, so the adapter always passes .filePath.
cursor-api stays a valid config value but the preflight returns unavailable because it rejects gateway image inputs at c7f2697.
pdf-text-layer is a local OCR vendor id that reads the PDF text layer, giving an offline path used by the smoke test.
Unavailable services persist nothing (no run record, pages stay pending); failed calls persist a run and an error message.
intentionalTradeoffs: All plans share one StriaCore module, so a worker's build can fail on another worker's in-progress file; such workers record 'blocked by foreign diagnostics' and post-join serial verification decides.
Default vendor anthropic with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is applied pending user confirmation (design-docs/user-qa/default-agent-config.md).
stria-app ships only as a SwiftPM executable; a GUI launch outside a shell may miss API-key env vars, and the app names the missing variable.
LIKE fallback search scores 0 and orders by document and page rather than relevance.
The agent-gateway call path itself is verified only by build and manual use; tests cover preflight, prompt parts and redaction.
supportedEdgeCases: Re-importing the same bytes is idempotent; a different file whose id prefix collides fails with idCollision.
An import interrupted during rendering resumes on the next import of the same file.

OCR unavailable (unknown vendor, cursor-api, missing model/apiKeyEnvironment, unset env var): import still succeeds with pages pending, no agent_runs rows, and a reason naming the variable but never its value.
Per-page OCR failures give status partial; --retry-failed and page selections re-run only the selected pending or failed pages under the concurrency bound.
Search queries with any term shorter than 3 Unicode scalars, or hosts without FTS5 trigram, use the LIKE fallback; Japanese text, NFKC normalization and % / _ escaping are handled.
Cross-document search and the --doc filter; unknown document ids throw documentNotFound.
A valid cached PNG is not rewritten; an invalid cache file is rewritten atomically.
A database with a newer user_version fails with databaseTooNew without modifying the file.
ask with no relevant pages persists nothing and never calls the model; failed model calls persist an error message; --limit outside 1...10 exits 2.
--help and --version do not create the data root; --home beats STRIA_HOME.
Run-log write failures do not fail the OCR or ask call.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Encrypted or password-protected PDFs beyond what PDFKit opens without a password.
Document deletion, schema migrations beyond v1, and downgrade of a newer database.
Streaming answers, per-call timeouts and agent session reuse.
GUI launches that lack API-key environment variables beyond naming the missing variable.
Real vendor network calls in tests; the GatewayPromptRunner path is compile-verified only.
Packaging stria-app as a signed .app bundle.
